cases.title: loads cleanly
a direct issue link opens a standalone editor and closes to All issues
saving an issue updates the list and survives navigating away and back
a failed save retains its draft and can be retried
closing and reopening an issue retains its fields and pending comment
issue drafts survive switching issues and browser history
dirty issue drafts prompt before reload and saved or discarded fields do not
project drafts survive navigation and a pending save settles in its own editor
a hidden dirty project editor protects reload and discarding it removes the warning
narrow screens open the issue editor directly and close returns to the list
project navigation filters canonical data and close returns to that project
an unknown project cannot open creation for a nonexistent project
creating an issue through the Dialog updates shared data and opens its route
creating from a Board column keeps its project and status defaults
search and status filters combine without changing shared issues
a filtered deep link restores its controls and results after reload
Back and Forward restore filters on distinct issue routes
issue reload and close preserve the filtered page URL
a modified native member issue link opens a new tab without moving the directory
malformed filter values use defaults and clear to the canonical URL
the command shortcut opens the palette and keyboard selection navigates to an issue
background activity waits for the full 20-second interval
a saved sidebar view restores its settings and deleting it returns to all issues
a saved-view issue panel survives reload without session preset metadata
a keyboard cross-column drop updates issue details and returns to the same board
keyboard drag reorders project issues and retains the order across navigation
posting a comment preserves a dirty issue draft and remains visible after reopening
a pointer drop stays in its target column before the save finishes
a board move stays in place before the save finishes and preserves keyboard focus
a cross-column drop stays in its new status before saving and keeps keyboard focus
a retained issue save settles while another issue is open
opening a notification preserves unread state and selecting it opens the issue
assignment and read state stay scoped to their recipient
